story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by knights and knaves. Knights always tell the truth, and knaves always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Isabella, and Liam. Isabella was heard saying, "Liam is a knave". Liam remarked, "Isabella is a knave or Isabella is a knight". So who is a knight and who is a knave?
